component.name: AVD4Linux
component.summary: Native Linux client for Azure Virtual Desktop with Smart Card redirection

description.p: AVD4Linux is a modern, native GTK 4 and Libadwaita client designed for accessing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) workspaces with first-class Smart Card (DoD CAC / PIV) redirection support.

ul.li: Full support for Azure Virtual Desktop in Azure US DoD, Azure US Government (GCC High), and Azure Commercial.
Native Smart Card / DoD CAC hardware token redirection via FreeRDP 3.
Seamless Entra ID Certificate-Based Authentication (CBA) via host PKCS#11.
Automatic Azure Virtual Desktop workspace resource detection and direct FreeRDP session launching.
Hardware-accelerated graphics rendering and audio redirection.

description.p: Added optional local device pass-through, disabled by default:

ul.li: Microphone pass-through (MS-RDPEAI) via a header bar toggle.
Webcam pass-through (MS-RDPECAM) via a header bar toggle, with a startup probe that detects FreeRDP builds lacking the rdpecam channel.
Settings persisted to ~/.config/avd4linux/settings.json with user-only permissions.
Microphone and camera directives supplied by a host pool are stripped and replaced with the user's local toggle state.

description.p: Initial release of AVD4Linux with support for:

ul.li: Azure Virtual Desktop DoD sovereign cloud (rdweb.wvd.azure.us) and DoD sovereign tenants.
